description: Get short interest data for a company: short volume, short ratio, days to cover and short percent of float. A null `shortInterestPercent` always carries `shortInterestPercentReason`: "float_not_point" means the float on record is a bound or estimate, and a percent-of-float is not computed from a bound or estimate; "float_unavailable" means no float of any kind is on record; "short_pct_of_float_unreconciled" means a point float existed but the ratio was implausible or the split basis could not be resolved; "float_class_scope_mismatch" means the float on record pools more than one separately listed share class (e.g. Class A plus Class D) while short interest is reported for this symbol's class only, so the two figures are not comparable. A null percent means not measured; it does not mean 0%.
name: get_short_interest
title: Get Short Interest
